title: lonicera sempervirens f. superba
intro: Lonicera sempervirens f. superba, commonly known as Coral Honeysuckle or Trumpet Honeysuckle, is a non-invasive, evergreen vine native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety due to its adaptogenic properties, promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera sempervirens f. superba include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, such as loganin and sweroside, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
